services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: Lee S.
reviews.text: Went to start my car and to my shock it would not start, but the dashboard lights still came on, as well as the radio, so was hoping the problem was a weakening battery. Called my auto insurance for roadside assistance, battery jump and possible car tow. Thought I was going to have to wait forever for a tow truck. The insurance company sent a text that someone from Courtesy Towing would be coming out. It wasn't even an hour and the driver was at the car! The driver they sent was Billy. He took at least 15 minutes to make sure the issue wasn't the battery. He really wanted to make sure the vehicle needed to be towed, and I SO appreciated his effort. Who still offers that kind of service in this day and age?? Once determined vehicle had to be towed, it was loaded onto the truck no problem. And while his tow skills are FANTASTIC, it was the customer service, down to earth professionalism and courtesy he showed during the ride to the garage that blew me away! Asking if the air was too cold or not cold enough, offering the use of a cup holder for my soda can, making sure the seat wasn't too hot, if I needed help getting out of the truck. He also shared some interesting information about the changes in the field of towing. Will definitely ask my auto insurance for this company again and will DEFINITELY ask them to send Billy!

reviews.author: Ashton Chavis
reviews.text: There isnt enough stars to rate this company! Billy and Scott were beyond helpful to me. It didnt take 10mins for them to reach where my children and I were stranded beside the road tonight. Scott was super quick with getting my tire changed. I would highly recommend this tow service!!! Wonderful and compassionate people!

reviews.author: James Murphy
reviews.text: Courtesy Towing is amazing. I needed my Classic 1954 Buick towed out to the car show this weekend. Their driver, Drew, was patient, kind and treated it with the kid gloves it needed. I will always use Chris & Drew in the future. Thank you very much for all of the patience, care and professionalism.

reviews.author: Ray Salermo
reviews.text: My BMW was needing some work done. Engine was in critical spot. I contacted this towing company, in less than 40 minutes my car was in the bed of the towing car ready to go. They understand the value of your car and a good paint job. They handled it like one of their own. Thank you.

reviews.author: Alisa H
reviews.text: Great people! I had Billy come and pick me up from an accident where my car was totaled. He is very personable and definitely got my mind off the accident. Scott and Billy worked with me while I was trying to get a new car while my old car was on their lot.

reviews.author: Dominic MacAulay
reviews.text: Billy helped me out today. It was so much easier than AAA, and I am very thankful for him helping me out with my car. He told me where to leave the keys, and kept me updated every step of the way. I couldn’t be happier!

reviews.author: Greg Christianson
reviews.text: The gentleman that towed my totaled car was great. Polite, informative, sympathetic. The main office manager Scott couldn’t be nicer! I was super impressed with their service overall… thank you Courtesy!

reviews.author: Scott Chappell
reviews.text: I highly recommend Courtesy Towing! They arrived timely to the accident to tow my vehicle and when I needed to go to the lot on Saturday, even though they were closed, Billy made a special trip to open the gate for me. Really good dude too!

reviews.author: Denis Kahrimanovic
reviews.text: Thank you Scott and Courtesy Equipment Transport and Towing for your help with towing my totaled vehicle and turning my license plate into dmv. Your friendly service and professional courtesy made my experience much easier.

reviews.author: acritical
reviews.text: The driver, Billy was on time and considerate. When loading my car, he placed down protectors to protect my driveway from damage from the roll-back. Courtesy Towing is my go to for towing needs for my business. Continuous happy customer. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Fredy Gallardo
reviews.text: I got a flat tire out of nowhere and I was lucky enough to find Brandon at the gas station who was super kind and friendly about the situation. He told me about his work at Courtesy Equipment Transport and Towing, and was able to quickly gather the tools to help replace my flat tire with the spare. If it weren’t for Brandon who knows how long I would’ve been stuck out in the cold. I definitely recommend and will remember them again in case of future situations.

reviews.author: adriana
reviews.text: The driver that came out was very professional, thoughtful, patient, and kind with my grandma. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Lisa Bird
reviews.text: The tow truck arrived 40 minutes earlier than anticipated. Because it was being towed to my dealer I didn't have to wait there, and when he arrived he called me with what he found was wrong. He was also very humorous and provided exceptional customer service. My drivers name was Scott and I would recommend him any day.

reviews.author: Dreemdiver
reviews.text: The driver (as well as the dispatcher) was very courteous. They went out of their way to accommodate my needs.if I ever need that type of service again I will definitely call on them!

reviews.author: Lily Anderson
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Courtesy Towing! I had to get my car towed late last night and was worried I wouldn't be able to get it towed til morning. Brandon was able to come out and showed up earlier than his estimated time of arrival and was able to quickly and safely load my car despite its bad location. He was friendly and professional! I can't say enough good things, it felt like a friend came out to help with my car. I'd definitely recommend Courtesy Towing to anyone in the area!

reviews.author: Amy Kollat
reviews.text: After dealing with the stress of having a car breaking down beyond financial repair, Courtesy Towing was a breath of fresh air. Both Scott and Josh were very conscientious and even suggested some options that I hadn’t thought of. Knowing that it would take two hours of travel time to get my car back home, I thought it would take at least a couple of days for them to fit me into their schedule however by noon the next day, my car was back at home at a very reasonable price. Would definitely recommend and use again!

reviews.author: Steve Dodgion
reviews.text: Highly recommend and will use again if needed. Billy was extra courteous and respectful while towing my SUV.

reviews.author: Cheyenne Victoria
reviews.text: I called Courtesy Towing because one of my company’s work vehicles developed a power steering problem in Raleigh. I called to hopefully get it towed and Scott was there within the hour! He towed our giant, heavy work truck from Raleigh to Fuquay and I didn’t have to worry about a thing. Responsive, professional, friendly and efficient! Thank you so much for saving the day!

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Courtesy Towing. They handled a multi-tow situation involving a truck and a boat with skill and efficiency. Scott and his crew were both pleasant and professional. They had us towed to multiple destinations in no time. Would recommend Courtesy Towing for all your towing needs in and around the Apex, New Hill, Holly Springs and Fuquay Varina NC areas. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Kirstyn Lokker
reviews.text: Great service at a competitive price. Owner offered options and recommendations on delivery method. Antique vehicle delivered on a roll-back from NC to a neighboring state. The responsiveness of Scott (owner) and Brandon (driver) was superb. They kept me abreast of the vehicle location starting from the point of pickup, to the overnight stay (at their secure yard) and finally during delivery. Driver was polite, respectful and overall a pleasure to talk with. Thanks Guys. Courtesy Towing is highly recommended.

reviews.author: Stuff
reviews.text: It’s far too often that towing companies get put in a situation where they have to be the ride that gets you home when you need it most. Courtesy towing was put in that spot recently when my car was totaled in the middle of nowhere. My insurance company was unable to help. And despite policy, Courtesy Towing gave me a ride back home that night. The service provided is beyond great, it’s very important for those who need it. Thank you for going above and beyond in these most needed situations.

reviews.author: Tom W.
reviews.text: Scott was fantastic to work with when needing towing assistance. I've worked with other local towing companies and the difference is that Scott has the business owner mindset and treats people with dignity and respect! I am so impressed that, as a Chatham County resident, I've saved his information in my phone for the next time I need help! THANKS SCOTT, YOU HAVE MY BUSINESS!!!!

reviews.author: Kathy K
reviews.text: Awesome service! I received a call from Dale telling me he was on his way. He was on time, friendly, courteous, and very quick. I would highly recommend Courtesy Towing, and have put their number in my phone in case I ever need them again!

reviews.author: Anitra Elmore
reviews.text: My insurance company contracted with them to tow my car. There was an issue with them towing it to the body shop and I called to correct it within minutes of the driver leaving. The person who answered the phone was to get back to me, but did not do so in a timely manner. I waited about a half hour before following up and she said they wouldn’t be bringing my car back to me. When I asked to speak to a supervisor, she hung up on me and did not answer the phone when I called again. They may do great work as a tow company, but their customer service leaves a great deal to be desired. My insurance company was able to contact them, but they continued to not answer the phone when I called to check on the status of my car. I would recommend you look elsewhere if you need a tow company that values customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: alex J
reviews.text: This company is amazing, the drivers are friendly and professional. The trucks are always clean and in tiptop shape, and as a towing company, they understand some of the inconvenience and hard spots they are put into, but always excel with communication and dealing with their client in a understanding way.!

reviews.author: Jon Carroll
reviews.text: I had submitted a claim through my insurance company for a vehicle that wouldn't start. In less than 15 minutes of making the call, courtesy towing arrived. The service was excellent, and they even emailed me a copy of the battery diagnosis read out. I would recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Mark Brengle
reviews.text: We recently had a work truck break down on the side of the highway, I called Scott and he had it back at our shop within the hour. We were able to get it fixed and back out to the jobsite all within a 2 hour period. As a small business, down time is critical, I can't thank Courtesy Towing enough for helping us out.

reviews.author: Dezarae Churchill
reviews.text: My grandma had a flat tire after church and Scott came within fifteen minutes from an AAA call. He changed the tire quickly and was extremely polite and helpful. Would recommend Courtesy towing to anyone in need! Thank you Scott!

reviews.author: Chris Leader
reviews.text: I run a humanitarian organization and was recently stranded with my commercial 26' box truck. My battery died, and I was stranded at a client's facility. I called Courtesy Towing, and they dispatched an employee immediately to assist me. The individual was incredibly knowledgable and helpful. As soon as he arrived, he was able to get the truck running and we were on our way! Courtesy Towing was quick, professional and reasonably priced! I would recommend their services to anyone!

reviews.author: Keith Stokes
reviews.text: These guy's are the best! I have used them three times now and have been extremely pleased and satisfied. The level of customer service I received from Courtesy Towing is the type of service Ken Blanchard and Sheldon Bowles writes about in their books about large successful companies. They "Get It!" I mean they understand they are in business to make money by offering a service and the customer has a choice where to spend their money. They are there when they say they will be there. They are able to carry on a converstion with you the customer and they make you feel like they want your business and not like they are doing you a favor... If you need one of the services Courtesy Towing offers, I highly recommend them and give them 5 stars for service. Thank you Courtesy Towing for being a "Customer Service" company.

reviews.author: Amr Mohamed
reviews.text: Courtesy towing was the company the police called for me after I got rear-ended on US-64. I had a frustrating time with insurance's company to pick up the car in a reasonable amount of time, they tried blaming Courtesy Towing for not responding fast enough at one point. I might have believed it except for the fact that Courtesy Towing did an amazing job keeping me updated to the minute. He let me know when they got requests for the total from insurance and that he responded soon after. Even when nothing was happening, I would get a text nearly every day letting me know that they're not there yet. I kept pushing my insurance company to use Courtesy Towing to send the car where it needs to go and they finally listened. Anyway, this company is awesome and keeping me posted has won me over and kept them from me thinking they were at fault for delays. Always pays to communicate. This company gets that!

reviews.author: Tim Johnson
reviews.text: Blew the engine on my 36 Ford truck today. Showed up ahead of estimate, pampered my truck, helped me push it in my garage, super pleasant an polite....and a reasonable price. Best towing experience ever.

reviews.author: Roger Hobbs
reviews.text: My wife had a flat. She called our insurance company's roadside assistant service. What a joke. Long story short, she was on the phone with them on and off for an hour and a half trying to explain where she was. Our roadside assistance "service" never showed up. Frustrate and tired, we called Courtesy Towing and they were there in 5 minutes. Literally, 5 minutes. Wish she just called them from the start! They are reliable, quick, reasonable and friendly. Keep their information in your wallet, in your car and in your phone!

reviews.author: Lee Jacobs
reviews.text: Called today for a tow after an accident. The driver who showed up (I’m sorry I forgot his name) offered to use a pry bag to pull the fender off the tire so the car would be drivable. As a result I was able to get the car home on my own rather than towing. I offered to pay for the service but he declined. All around this far surpassed any expectation!

reviews.author: Thomas Blake
reviews.text: Scott was great. Really has great customer service skills. Justin called before he got here and was very professional. All around so pleased with the service. Price was on point.

reviews.author: Eric Lamb
reviews.text: Courtesy Towing helped me get my broken down boat trailer back to my house. Very impressed with their knowledge and how they took their time to do the job right. If you live in the Apex, Cary, Chatham County area, these guys should be your first choice in towing.

reviews.author: Travis Mckay
reviews.text: Billy was the driver that came out to help us. Great work and great customer relations. Highly recommend using this company when possible.

reviews.author: Gary V
reviews.text: My Mustang GT spun off the road following a wintery storm. Scott from Courtesy did a wonderful, safe job pulling my car back onto the street under freezing, unsafe road conditions. I highly recommend their service for your towing needs!

reviews.author: Kathleen Marsocci
reviews.text: I can't praise Scott with Courtesy Towing enough. I've used them for towing and to unlock my car. They were on time and very professional. Awesome work. They are my go to now.

reviews.author: Ron Cox
reviews.text: Great experience with Scott and Drew. Drew did a great job with moving a tractor and equipment for me. I would definitely recommend this company and will be calling them again next time I need help.

reviews.author: Brian Augustus
reviews.text: I always use Scott for my towing needs. Scott and his staff are always on time and very polite. Between the fair price and the reliable staff I would give them 5 stars!

reviews.author: Ben Davis
reviews.text: Definitely the most professional towing service out there. I use them for work frequently and likely have 50+ tows with them. Justin and Brandon always provide excellent service.

reviews.author: Anna King
reviews.text: I had a great experience being towed by these guys. Brandon was all around postive and patient person that was nothing but helpful during the stressful event of a flat tire. Would most defiantly call these guys next time I need a tow!

reviews.author: Savage Hulk
reviews.text: On Thursday 9/1/2016 I went to start my car and nothing. I needed to get to leith chrylser in Raleigh. When Brandon Showed up he shook my hand took his time loading my car. We couldn't put in neutral wheels were stuck, He knew just what to do. Not only did he get me there on time he did it in a very safe manner during the start of rush hour traffic. I would to thank Scott the owner for sending Brandon. Please Please if you need to be towed give them a call.

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.text: It was a courtesy for courtesy towing to come out and transport my camper back home. Tommy had stellar quality customer service.!!! these guys are highly recommended!!!!

reviews.author: Matt Berry
reviews.text: Courtesy towing always arrives in a timely manner, very professional. Would not look any further for a towing company. Not to mention their prices are just outstanding!

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.text: quick and easy - called on Thursday for an abandoned car in my business parking lot and they came the next day and took care of it!

reviews.author: Deb McNaughton
reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish. Highly recommend them for all your towing needs. They made an inconvenient experience easier.

reviews.author: Mike King
reviews.text: Great job loading and unloading my motorcycle. Obviously knows what he's doing. Scott is friendly and helpful and a pleasure to work with. Hope I don't need to, but I would call on him in the future.

reviews.author: Caitlin Conn
reviews.text: Had to have my husbands car towed and the guy that did it was so nice, on time and got it done quickly. Stress free experience.

reviews.author: Justin Marchant
reviews.text: Brandon towed my motorcycle today. Took excellent care of my bike and great customer service. Will be my go to from now on

reviews.author: John Blue
reviews.text: One of the best business experiences I've had in quite some time. The entire staff is very friendly , professional and really know how to treat customers.

reviews.author: Best Plumber99
reviews.text: Nicely done! Called and got the best price around and to top that off had my truck home in less that 30 minutes after the call thanks alot!

reviews.author: Evren Nardali
reviews.text: Absolutely professional and lives up to the name Courtesy. Tommy tows campers and heavier RVs and could not ask for better service.

reviews.author: Robyn Tolley
reviews.text: The customer service was excellent. They are fast, friendly and the price is just right. I would recommend them every time.

reviews.author: Ivory Jean Alexander
reviews.text: Will try to charge you for days they are closed, had to get the police involved. Will also try to keep your stuff until you sign your title over to them. Sketchy practices.
